notes: Steady convection-diffusion in a 4 x 1 channel drawn as an SVG: a heated round obstacle (u = 1) in a flow with the parabolic profile v_x = 6 U y (1 - y) (mean speed U), -k (u_xx + u_yy) + v_x u_x = 0. Cold fluid enters (u = 0), the walls are insulated and the outlet lets the heat leave (u_n = 0). The warm wake stretches downstream; raise U or lower k for a longer, thinner one (a finer mesh is needed when the cell Peclet number v h / k passes about 2).

geometry.name: channel_obstacle.svg
geometry.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="-0.1 -1.1 4.2 1.2">
  <!-- A 4 x 1 channel, 0 < y < 1 in the app (SVG's y points down and the
       app flips it), with a round obstacle at (1, 0.5). -->
  <path id="inlet" d="M 0 0 L 0 -1" fill="none" stroke="#2a78d6" stroke-width="0.02"/>
  <path data-region="wall" d="M 0 -1 L 4 -1" fill="none" stroke="#898781" stroke-width="0.02"/>
  <path id="outlet" d="M 4 -1 L 4 0" fill="none" stroke="#eb6834" stroke-width="0.02"/>
  <path data-region="wall" d="M 4 0 L 0 0" fill="none" stroke="#898781" stroke-width="0.02"/>
  <path id="obstacle" d="M 1.2 -0.5 A 0.2 0.2 0 1 0 0.8 -0.5 A 0.2 0.2 0 1 0 1.2 -0.5 Z" fill="none" stroke="#1baf7a" stroke-width="0.02"/>
</svg>
